blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.
blocks.zh: 基于团体的有可核查的奖励的强化学习,往往让全失败的团体承担长视野的代理任务:每个被抽样的轨迹都得到零奖励,使团体相对的方法没有基于奖励的政策梯度. 共同的补救方法从更强大的模型中提供完整的解决方案,但完整的轨迹代价高昂并让学习者接触到长期不政策的历史. 我们引入了SPLICE,它从当前政策失败的线上构建出本地培训目标. 对于每个全失败组,一个建议书模型会选择当前政策轨迹中的相接点,并从该点产生几个有界限的选项. 我们利用重复的当前政策延续来估计每个选项的价值,将正值估计数转换成一个加权的当地目标,并适应目前关于选项的政策。 我们评价了两个政策家族的SPLICE, 两项长距离代理任务, 软件工程与SWE-bench验证, 和深层研究与浏览Comp-Plus。 SPLICE 成绩优于 GRPO和所有四种环境下的全导轨指导基线,比GRPO提高了2.8-9.8个百分点. 在最初失败的SWE任务上,它提高了GRPO的毕业率10.8个百分点. 进一步的实验表明,SPLICE提高了性能,同时降低了昂贵的建议书模型计算.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLM agents solve long-horizon tasks through sequences of decisions and environment interactions [ 30 , 36 ] . Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains these agents using outcome feedback, such as whether a code change passes a test suite. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns advantages by comparing rewards within a group of trajectories sampled for the same task [ 26 ] . With binary outcome rewards, a group in which every trajectory fails has zero reward variation and provides no reward-based policy gradient. We refer to this case as an all-fail group . Such a group leaves the policy without a successful trajectory to reinforce, even when some intermediate decisions could support a successful continuation.
blocks.zh: LLM代理通过决定和环境相互作用的序列来解决长视距任务[30,36]. 用可核查的奖励(RLVR)加强学习,利用结果反馈来培训这些代理人,例如代码更改是否通过测试套件. 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)通过比较一组为同一项任务所抽样的轨迹中的奖励来分配优势[26]. 有了二进制结果奖励,每个轨迹都失败的团体的奖励没有变化,没有奖励政策梯度。 我们把这个案子称为一个失败的集团。 这种集团使政策得不到成功的加强,即使一些中间决定能够支持成功的延续。

blocks.en: External guidance offers a direct way to recover learning signals from all-fail groups by introducing successful behaviors that the current policy rarely generates. Existing methods for GRPO often derive such guidance from complete task-level solutions [ 29 , 16 , 34 ] . This choice treats a complete solution as the source of guidance. For long-horizon agents, however, a failure may be localized: a short corrective segment can lead to a state from which the current policy can complete the remaining task.
blocks.zh: 外部指导通过引入当前政策很少产生的成功行为,为从全失败群体中恢复学习信号提供了直接途径. 全球绩效评估的现有方法往往取自完整的任务一级解决办法[29、16、34]。 这种选择将一个完整的解决方案作为指导的来源. 然而,对于长视野的代理人来说,失败可能是局部性的:短短的纠正部分会导致一种状态,从这种状态中,现行政策可以完成所余任务.

blocks.en: Thus, using complete solutions in this long-horizon setting incurs both computational and distributional costs. A complete long-horizon trajectory may span tens or hundreds of interaction turns (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B rollouts on our SWE tasks average 83.7 agent turns). Repeatedly generating such trajectories with a strong proposal model requires expensive inference. The proposal model is requested even for decisions that the current policy can already make. Also, using long pre-collected trajectories as supervision exposes the learner to off-policy risk, increasing the mismatch between the training distribution and the current policy’s behavior [ 15 , 23 , 24 ] . These costs pose two design problems. The first is allocating proposal-model computation to bottlenecks encountered by current policy. The second is converting local proposals into a training target that reflects the current policy’s ability to complete the task after each proposal.
blocks.zh: 因此,在这种长距离环境下使用完整的解决方案既需要计算成本,也需要分配成本。 完整的长视距轨迹可能跨越数十个或数百个相互作用转弯(例如,我们SWE任务平均转弯为Qwen3.5-9B)。 以强力建议模型反复产生这种轨迹需要昂贵的推断. 即使对于现行政策已经作出的决定,也要求提供建议模式。 此外,将长期预收的轨迹作为监督使学习者面临政策外的风险,加剧了培训分配与现行政策行为[15、23、24]之间的不匹配。 这些费用造成了两个设计问题。 首先是将建议书模型计算分配给现行政策所遇到瓶颈。 第二点是将地方建议转变为培训目标,反映现行政策在每项建议之后完成任务的能力。

blocks.en: We address both problems with SPLICE, which introduces failure-localized option splicing with current-policy continuation evaluation. For an all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in one current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options. We splice each option at this point, return control to the current policy, and sample repeated continuations to task completion. Their terminal outcomes estimate the option’s current-policy continuation value, and we convert the positive values into a return-weighted local target. Only all-fail groups enter this splice branch, while other groups continue with standard GRPO. The bounded options save expensive proposal-model inference, while anchoring them in a current-policy history and supervising on the local target limits off-policy exposure.
blocks.zh: 我们解决了SPLICE的两个问题,它引入了失败本地化的选项,并结合了当前政策持续评价。 对于一个全失败的集团,一个建议模型在一个当前政策轨迹中选择一个相接点,并产生几个有界限的选项. 我们在此分解每个选项,将控制还原为现行政策,并抽样重复完成任务。 它们的终极结果估计了该选项当前政策的持续价值,我们把正值转换成一个回报加权的当地目标。 只有全失败的组进入此切入分支,而其他组则继续使用标准的GRPO. 限定范围的备选方案节省了昂贵的提案模型推论,同时将它们固定在当前政策历史中,并监督地方目标限制政策外接触。

blocks.en: We evaluate SPLICE on Software Engineering and Deep Research tasks. Across SWE-bench Verified and BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GRPO by 2.8–9.8 percentage points. On a fixed set of initially failed SWE tasks, it raises graduation rate from 8.1% to 18.9%. SPLICE uses fewer proposal-model rollout turns than full-trajectory guidance baselines while achieving better performance. Extensive experiments show that SPLICE can recover all-fail tasks without requiring the proposal model to generate or supervise complete trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于软件工程和深层研究任务的SPLICE. 通过SWE-bench验证并浏览Comp-Plus,其GRPO改进了2.8-9.8个百分点. 在一套固定的最初失败的SWE任务上,它将毕业率从8.1%提高到了18.9%. SPLICE在取得更好的性能的同时,使用的建议模型推出转弯比全导轨指导基线少. 广泛的实验表明,SPLICE可以回收全部故障任务而无需建议模型生成或监督完整的轨迹.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: (1) We introduce SPLICE, which formulates recovery from all-fail groups in long-horizon agent RL as learner-conditioned option splicing. This formulation allocates costly proposal-model computation only to splice points selected online. (2) We use current-policy continuation returns to define a target distribution over proposed options. By splicing bounded options into current-policy histories and fitting to this local distribution online, the update limits off-policy exposure relative to full-trajectory guidance. (3) We show across Software Engineering and Deep Research tasks that SPLICE improves performance and recovery of initially failed tasks while reducing proposal-model cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: (1) 我们引入SPLICE,它将长视特效RL的全故障组恢复为学习者有条件的选项分型。 这种提法只将昂贵的建议书模型计算分配给在线选定的点。 (2) 我们利用现行政策继续收益确定拟议备选方案的目标分布。 通过将捆绑的选项扩展入当前政策历史,并适合在线本地发行,更新限制了政策外的接触与全导出指导的关系。 (3)我们在整个软件工程和深层研究任务中显示,SPLICE在降低建议书模型成本的同时,提高了最初失败任务的性能和恢复.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Agentic RL and All-Fail Groups
blocks.zh: 2.1 代理RL和全福集团

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning has been extended from single-response reasoning to agents that act over multiple turns in stateful environments [ 28 , 30 ] . These settings often use sparse trajectory-level rewards from executable verifiers, which allow policy optimization over complete sequences of reasoning, actions, and environment observations. GRPO samples a group of trajectories for the same task and estimates each advantage from its return relative to the group, avoiding a learned value model [ 26 , 5 ] . The resulting update depends on reward variation among trajectories sampled from the same task.
blocks.zh: 强化学习已经从单一反应推理扩展到在状态环境中多次转弯的代理人[28、30]。 这些设置往往使用可执行核查人提供的少量的轨迹级奖励,这使得政策优化能够超越推理、行动和环境观测的完整序列。 GRPO为同一任务抽取了一组轨迹并估计了相对于该组的回回的每个优势,避免了学习到的值模型[26,5]. 由此产生的更新取决于从同一任务中取样的轨迹之间的奖励差异。

blocks.en: Under binary outcome rewards, an all-fail group has zero reward for every trajectory, so its reward-relative advantages vanish. All-fail groups contain no positive trajectory to reinforce, making exploration on hard tasks the central problem. Existing methods reallocate sampling or filter zero-variance groups [ 32 , 35 ] , construct advantages from failed responses [ 13 ] , or revise failures using gold answers [ 8 ] . External guidance offers another route by proposing behaviors that the current policy rarely samples, which we review below.
blocks.zh: 在二进制结果奖励下,一个全失败的团体对每一轨迹的奖励都是零的,因此其奖励相对的优势消失了. 所有失败的团体没有积极的轨道可以加强,使艰苦任务的探索成为中心问题。 现有方法再分配采样或过滤零变量组[32,35],从失败的响应中构建优势[13],或使用金子答案修改失败[8]. 外部指导通过提出当前政策很少采样的行为提供了另一种途径,我们下面对此进行回顾.

blocks.en: 2.2 External Guidance in RL
blocks.zh: 2.2 远程教育外部指导

blocks.en: One line of work conditions RL rollouts on precomputed hints or prefixes, while optimizing only the policy-generated continuation [ 34 , 25 , 20 , 11 , 31 , 18 ] . Another line trains directly on complete external solutions through supervised, off-policy, or mixed-policy objectives [ 7 , 33 , 16 , 29 ] . Such guidance is often derived from expert solutions, while direct supervision requires complete expert trajectories. Generating these trajectories is expensive for long-horizon agents, and expert-induced histories can differ from those visited by the current policy, creating covariate shift and compounding errors [ 15 , 23 ] . Concurrent work RSTG combines GRPO with on-policy distillation (OPD) on teacher solutions for all-fail groups [ 9 ] , requiring aligned teacher and student token spaces. SPLICE instead queries a proposal model online for short options at selected splice points in current-policy trajectories. Learner-conditioned continuation evaluation and local supervision reduce proposal-model cost and limit off-policy exposure.
blocks.zh: 一行工作条件 RL 在预计算提示或前缀上推出,而优化的只是政策产生的续作[34,25,20,11,31,18]. 另一班直通外部解决方案的直通列车通过监督,非政策,或混合政策目标[7,33,16,29]. 这种指导往往取自专家的解决办法,而直接监督则需要完整的专家轨迹。 产生这些轨迹对于远视物剂来说是昂贵的,而由专家引起的历史可能与目前政策所访问的历史不同,造成相去甚远的转变和复合出错[15,23]. 同时期工作 RSTG将GRPO与关于全失败群体教师解决方案的政策分解(OPD)相结合[9],需要校对的师生象征性空间. SPLICE转而在线查询当前政策轨迹中选定相接点的短选项的建议书模型。 学习者有条件的继续评估和地方监督可降低建议书模型的成本并限制政策外的接触。

blocks.en: Splice-point selection and branch reconstruction. For each group 𝒢 \mathcal{G} routed to Splice , we randomly select one failed trajectory τ − \tau^{-} from 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . The proposal model uses the task, full interaction history, and terminal verifier feedback to select b t ∗ b_{t^{*}} among branchable points recorded every C C agent turns. blocks.en: Tasks and data. For Software Engineering (SWE) , we combine subsets of SWE-Gym [ 19 ] and R2E-Gym [ 10 ] , excluding tasks from repositories that overlap with SWE-bench. We evaluate resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified [ 12 ] . For Deep Research , we use a dataset curated from open-source datasets with a quality-control pipeline, which Appendix B.2 describes. We evaluate answer accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus [ 1 ] , using Qwen3-Embedding-8B as the retriever and gpt-oss-20b as the judge model. To give all methods access to the same amount and distribution of training data, we sample a fixed subset of 3,200 tasks for both SWE and Deep Research. We report SWE and Deep Research performance in the main results, and further analyses use SWE.

Comparison Setup. We consider SPLICE, SFT, RL, SFT+RL, and ReLIFT, starting from the same initial policy and using the common 3,200-task subset for each task domain. This protocol controls the available task data rather than method-specific computation, which we compare separately in Section 5.4 .
For SFT , the proposal model generates one full trajectory for every task in the common subset, and rejection sampling retains only successful trajectories for supervised fine-tuning. RL applies GRPO directly to the initial policy. SFT+RL initializes from the resulting SFT checkpoint and runs GRPO for the same number of RL steps as SPLICE.
We adapt ReLIFT [ 16 ] to the online setting by requesting one full proposal-model trajectory for each task with an all-fail group and adding it to the buffer only upon verified success. Following the original method, ReLIFT triggers a fine-tuning step when the buffer contains at least 64 examples.

比较设置. 我们认为,SPLICE、SFT、RL、SFT+RL和ReLIFT是从相同的初始政策开始的,在每个任务领域使用共同的3 200个任务子集。 本协议控制现有任务数据,而不是特定方法的计算,我们在第5.4节中单独比较.
对 SFT 来说,建议模型为共同子集中的每一项任务产生一个完整的轨迹,拒绝采样只保留了成功的轨迹来进行有监督的微调. RL直接将GPRO应用于初始政策. SFT+RL从由此而来的SFT检查站初始化,并运行GRPO,用于与SPLICE相同的RL步骤.
我们根据在线设置调整了ReLIFT[16],要求每个任务有一个完整的建议模型轨迹,一个全失败组,并且只有在核实成功后才将其添加到缓冲器中. 遵循原始方法,当缓冲器包含至少64个实例时会触发一个微调步骤.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 : Main results on SWE-bench Verified and BrowseComp-Plus. Qwen3-8B-CS is the cold-start checkpoint described in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Table 1 first shows the limitation of applying RL directly to the initial policy. RL improves performance in all four settings, but the gains over the initial policy are limited to 3.7–5.2 percentage points. This modest improvement is consistent with the sparse-reward exploration bottleneck: GRPO can reinforce sampled successes but obtains no reward-based gradient from all-fail groups.
blocks.zh: 表1首先列出了对初始政策直接适用最低限值的限制。 RL在所有四个环境下都提高了性能,但相对于初始政策的收益被限制在3.7-5.2个百分点. 这一微小的改善与回报微薄的勘探瓶颈是一致的: GRPO可以加强抽样成功,但不能从所有失败群体获得基于奖励的梯度。

blocks.en: Providing successful trajectories before RL yields substantially stronger results. SFT+RL outperforms direct RL by 1.5–8.5 points across the four settings, while the RL stage improves its SFT initialization by a further 1.2–2.9 points. These results show that RL achieves better performance after SFT has exposed the policy to successful task trajectories.
blocks.zh: 提供成功的轨迹,然后再使用RL,结果会大得多。 SFT+RL在四个设置中比直接RL高出1.5-8.5分,而RL阶段则将SFT的初始化进一步提高了1.2-2.9分. 这些结果显示,在SFT将政策暴露于成功的任务轨迹后,RL取得了更好的性能.

blocks.en: Online external guidance offers an alternative way to supply successful behavior during RL. ReLIFT improves over direct RL by 0.7–3.8 points, showing that online guidance improves final performance in this comparison. SPLICE improves further over ReLIFT by 2.1–6.0 points and exceeds the higher-compute SFT+RL baseline by 1.3–2.6 points. It therefore achieves the highest performance in all four settings. These comparisons support the use of learner-conditioned local options rather than complete proposal trajectories for external guidance.
blocks.zh: 在线外部指导为提供RL期间的成功行为提供了另一种方式. ReLIFT比直接RL改进了0.7–3.8分,表明在线指导在这个比较中改善了最终性能. SPLICE比ReLIFT进一步提高了2.1–6.0分,并比较高的计算出SFT+RL基线高出了1.3–2.6分. 因此,它在所有四个场合都取得了最高的性能. 这些比较支持使用学习者有条件的本地选项,而不是完整的外部指导建议轨迹.

blocks.en: Continuation Policy and Supervision Scope. We first replace current-policy continuations with proposal-model continuations while retaining supervision only on the bounded options. This change improves Resolve from 25.7% to 26.2% and Graduation from 18.9% to 19.4%, but raises proposal-model rollout turns from 93.5k to 372.5k, or 4.0 × 4.0\times as many turns. The full-suffix variant also supervises the action tokens in successful proposal-generated continuations. Full-suffix supervision lowers both Resolve and Graduation while using 365.9k proposal-model turns. blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Limitations. SPLICE introduces current-policy rollout computation because each option is evaluated through multiple continuations. Our asynchronous pipeline adds limited wall-clock time in our experiments, but the cost may be larger in environments with expensive execution. Also, estimating each option value from three continuations introduces sampling error. Increasing its accuracy requires more current-policy continuations or a stronger model, creating a trade-off between estimation quality and inference cost.
blocks.zh: 限制。 SPLICE引入了当前政策推出计算,因为每个选项都通过多次续作来评价. 我们同步的管道增加了我们实验中有限的时钟时间,但在执行费用昂贵的环境中,成本可能更大. 此外,从三个续作中估计每个选项值都会产生取样错误。 提高其准确性需要更多的现行政策延续或更强有力的模式,在估计质量和推论成本之间形成取舍。

blocks.en: Conclusion. We introduced SPLICE, a training method that recovers learning signals from all-fail rollout groups in long-horizon agent RL. It splices bounded proposal-model options into failed current-policy trajectories online. We evaluate each option through current-policy continuations and train on the resulting return-weighted local target. Replacing complete proposal trajectories with local options online reduces proposal-model cost and limits off-policy exposure and covariate shift. Across two policy families and two agent tasks, SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance, with particularly strong recovery on initially failed tasks.
blocks.zh: 结论。 我们引入了SPLICE,一种训练方法,从长距离特效RL的全故障推出组恢复学习信号. 它将建议书模式选项捆绑到网上失败的当前政策轨迹中。 我们通过现行政策的延续来评价每个选项,并根据由此产生的加权回报率地方目标进行培训。 将完整的建议书轨迹与本地选项在线取而代之,可以降低建议书模型成本并限制政策外的曝光和共变转变. 在两个政策家庭和两个代理任务中,SPLICE的绩效超过了GRPO和全导出指导,在最初失败的任务上特别强劲的恢复.

blocks.en: Appendix B Training Data
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训数据

blocks.en: B.1 Software Engineering
blocks.zh: B.1 软件工程

blocks.en: We construct the SWE training pool from subsets of SWE-Gym [ 19 ] and R2E-Gym [ 10 ] . SWE-Gym collects real-world issue-resolution tasks from pull requests in Python repositories and pairs each task with an executable environment and expert-validated tests [ 19 ] . It contains 2,438 tasks, while we omit 31 tasks because their container images are unavailable. R2E-Gym procedurally constructs executable tasks from repository commits through back-translation and test collection or generation [ 10 ] . We use its subset of 4,578 tasks from repositories that do not overlap with SWE-bench.
blocks.zh: 我们从SWE-Gym[19]和R2E-Gym[10]的子集构建出SWE训练池. SWE-Gym从 Python 寄存器中拉出请求来收集现实世界的问题解析任务,并将每个任务配以可执行环境和专家验证测试[19]. 它包含2,438个任务,而我们省略了31个任务,因为没有它们的容器图像. R2E-Gym在程序上构建寄存器的可执行任务,通过回译和测试收集或生成[10]. 我们使用它的子集4,578项任务,这些任务不与SWE-bench重叠。

blocks.en: B.2 Deep Research Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 深海研究数据集建设

blocks.en: We draw candidate tasks from five public releases, which are OpenResearcher [ 14 ] , DeepForge from OffSeeker [ 37 ] , OpenSeeker [ 6 ] , REDSearcher [ 2 ] and public Deep Research SFT datasets released by Kyle Montgomery [ 17 ] . Some releases provide complete interaction traces in addition to question–answer pairs. We extract only the query and reference answer.
blocks.zh: 我们从5个公开发布中抽取候选任务,即OpenResearcher [14],DeepForge from OffSeeker [37],OpenSeeker [6],REDSearcher [2] 和由凯尔·蒙哥马利发布的公共深层研究SFT数据集 [17]. 有些发行除了问答对等之外,还提供了完整的交互痕迹. 我们只提取查询和参考答案。

blocks.en: We canonicalize each query with Unicode NFKC normalization, case folding, and whitespace collapsing. We then deduplicate the normalized queries jointly across all five sources, obtaining 75,372 unique candidates.
blocks.zh: 我们以 Unicode NFKC 的正常化、 案件折叠、 和白空间倒塌来对每个查询进行分类 。 然后,我们将所有五个来源的正常查询合并进行,获得75 372名独特的候选人。

blocks.en: Collection dates and retrieval systems differ across these releases, so a reference answer may be ambiguous, outdated, or unsupported in our web environment. We audit every candidate with DeepSeek-V4-Flash [ 3 ] under a unified environment. The model can call search , open , and find , and Serper provides web search and reading services. 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/ We accept a task only when the audit answer agrees with its reference and the current search results provide supporting evidence. This common audit removes ill-posed questions, stale answers, and tasks whose evidence is no longer reachable. The final pool contains 16,855 Deep Research training tasks.
blocks.zh: 收集日期和检索系统在这些版本中各不相同,因此在我们网络环境中,参考答案可能模糊不清、过时或不支持。 我们用DeepSeek-V4-Flash[3]在一个统一的环境中对每个候选人进行审计. 该模型可以调用搜索,打开,并找到,Serper提供网络搜索和阅读服务. 1 1 1 1 https://serper.dev/. 只有当审计答复同意其参考文献,而且目前的查询结果提供了佐证时,我们才接受一项任务。 这种共同的审计消除了那些被怀疑的问题,僵硬的答案,以及那些证据已经无法达到的任务. 最终的人才库包含16,855个"深研究"培训任务.

blocks.en: We sample 500 SWE tasks and 500 Deep Research tasks from the data pool described in Appendix B . Qwen3.5-122B-A10B generates candidate trajectories, and rejection sampling retains trajectories that pass the corresponding verifier. We mix the retained SWE and Deep Research trajectories into one set and fine-tune the released Qwen3-8B checkpoint to obtain Qwen3-8B-CS.

blocks.en: Appendix D Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 附录D 培训 配置

blocks.en: We train on four compute nodes, each containing 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs. For the RL baseline, all four nodes run the student policy, with the trainer and rollout actor colocated on the same GPUs. For SPLICE and ReLIFT, three nodes use this colocated student setup, while the remaining node serves the proposal model. Training is asynchronous with a maximum rollout staleness of 2. Each rollout batch contains 32 groups, with G = 8 G=8 trajectories per group, and the actor learning rate is 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . For the SFT baseline, we train for three epochs with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 我们用四个计算节点进行训练,每个节点包含8个NVIDIA H200 GPU. 对于RL基线,所有四个节点都运行学生政策,教练和推出演员在同一GPU上合用. 对于SPLICE和ReLIFT,有3个节点使用这种同地学生设置,而剩下的节点则服务于提议模型. 训练是同步进行的,最大推出停滞为2个。 每个推出批次包含32个组,每组G=8个G=8个出轨,演员学习率为2×10−6 2\times 10×6}. 对于SFT基线,我们训练三个时代,学习率为1×10−5 1\times 10×5}.

blocks.en: Appendix E Task-Difficulty Partition
blocks.zh: 附录 E 任务差异 分区

blocks.en: We construct fixed difficulty subsets from the 3,200-task SWE training set before training. We run Qwen3-8B-CS and Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct once on each task and assign labels from their verified outcomes. A task is Easy if Qwen3-8B-CS succeeds, regardless of the Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct outcome. Among the remaining tasks, those solved by Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct are Medium , and those on which both models fail are Hard . The labeling runs yield success rates of 10.7% for Qwen3-8B-CS and 43.6% for Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, with 308 tasks solved by both models. The resulting partition contains 342 Easy, 1,087 Medium, and 1,771 Hard tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们从培训前的3 200个任务SWE培训中构建固定的难度子集。 我们在每个任务上运行了Qune3-8B-CS和Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct一次,并从其核实的结果中指定了标签. 一个任务如果Quen3-8B-CS成功,则容易,不管Quen3-Coder-30B-A3B-指令结果如何. 在剩下的任务中,由Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct解决的都是中度任务,而两个模型都失败的则是难. 标签运行成功率为:Qune3-8B-CS为10.7%;Qune3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct为43.6%,其中308项任务由两种模式解决. 由此产生的分区包括342个Easy,1,087个中段和1,771个硬任务.

blocks.en:
Highest-entropy selection lowers Resolve by 0.5 points and Graduation by 0.6 points relative to random selection (Table 6 ), indicating that local policy uncertainty alone does not identify better splice points.
Proposal-model selection improves Resolve by 1.3 points and Graduation by 1.1 points over random selection; relative to highest-entropy selection, the gains are 1.8 and 1.7 points, respectively.
These results suggest that conditioning on the full failed trajectory and terminal feedback provides a more useful selection signal than either random choice or local token entropy.
